title: An ambient automorphism fixing a smooth section acts trivially on its dualizing line
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $N>0$ an integer with $NA=0$, and $Y$ a Noetherian scheme with $N$ invertible in $\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth, separated, compactifiable, of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-asd-compactifiable], and $s:Y\hookrightarrow X$ a closed section [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Work in the ordinary etale derived categories, and put $C=s^*f^\times A$, using the compact-support right adjoint and the actual counit-defined section comparison of [lem-pur-noetherian-etale-section-specialization]. Let $a:X\xrightarrow{\sim}X$ satisfy $fa=f$ and $as=s$. For its Cartesian square $(a,f,f,1_Y)$ [def-pc-fibre-product], the section comparison $(1_Y)^*C\to C$ equals the canonical identity-inverse-image isomorphism. This is an assertion about one automorphism; it has no deformation family or specialization map.

proof.text: Shift the section dualizing complex by -2d. Smooth tensor duality identifies it with a locally constant free rank-one A-sheaf. Equality of its endomorphisms is equality of stalk scalars.

Use centred etale coordinates at the section. The local fundamental-class generator is normalized by the affine-space compact-support trace. An isomorphism fixing the section has local degree one, so transitivity of this trace and the etale inverse-image/counit comparison preserve that generator. Applying the inverse isomorphism gives the inverse comparison, excluding any multiplicity.

The scalar is one at every geometric stalk. Fully faithfulness of the degree-zero embedding and conservative geometric stalks imply equality before shifting. Restoring the shift and the identity-inverse-image comparison gives the equation. Rank zero is the etale identity-counit equation; the empty base and zero ring give equality in zero categories.

theorem sectionMap_automorphism
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f] [HasCompactification f]
    (s : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion s] (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 Y)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (a : X ≅ X)
    (sq : IsPullback a.hom f f (𝟙 Y)) (hsect : s ≫ a.hom = (𝟙 Y) ≫ s) :
    sectionMap A f f (𝟙 Y) a.hom sq s s hsect =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).hom.app
        (sectionInvariant A f s)
